title: Continuous-curvature G² squircle mask and glass bevel vs CSS border-radius
blurb: Clip a live HTML widget dock inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas with a continuous-curvature G² squircle SDF and glass bevel, paired with a split-curtain comparison against CSS border-radius.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas clip a live interactive HTML widget dock to a continuous-curvature G² superellipse squircle with a pointer-lit inner glass bevel, while keeping buttons, colour swatches and text inputs clickable and showing the flat-to-arc kink against CSS border-radius?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass, 0.93 MP (994×935, 7.44 MB) on one ElementGL context, corner fill grows 78.5% -> 94.7% -> 98.6% across n=2..10, 270 px shoulder difference vs CSS border-radius, and elementsFromPoint() hits every tile control.
